description: Fires most strongly when I (to move) have three of a horizontal four on row 2 (third row) with the gap in column 1 or 2 still low (height 0-1), and opponent stones sit directly on top of my row-2 stones on row 3. Not for the same shape on other rows, the right side, or colors swapped; opponent stones low in column 4 suppress it. Many weak firings have no clear pattern.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero moves the move probabilities by at most ~5 points (e.g. +5 column 3, -5 column 2 in one position).
notes: Best dev F1 0.208 (P 0.22, R 0.20, AUROC 0.59), simulation share 0.07. Minimal pairs confirm the row-2/left-side/color asymmetry for the top pattern, but a cap-pair feature (my row-2 stone under their row-3 stone, cols 0-3) is present in ~68% of firing yet in 41% of all positions; single far cells (X at (1,0), O in column 4) swing activation by 3 units. Behaves like a distributed sum of cell contributions; possibly a random direction or mixture. 7 of 8 score calls used (one wasted re-scoring p1).
